source: Minecraft 1.7.10 client jar, javap -c -constants. Obfuscated names: GuiIngame = bbv, Minecraft = bao, RenderGlobal = bma, EffectRenderer = bkn, WorldClient = bjf, GameSettings = bbj, Profiler = qi, Profiler.Result = qj, MathHelper = qh, Direction = p. Labels: bytecode-read, probed, assumed.
label: bytecode-read unless a field says otherwise

toggle.key: F3 (LWJGL 61) on key down toggles GameSettings.showDebugInfo (bbj.ax); showDebugProfilerChart (bbj.ay) = Shift held at that moment (bdw.r: LWJGL 42 or 54)

draw.style: Gui.drawString -> FontRenderer.drawStringWithShadow (shadow = true); no background box; no GL scale; coordinates are GUI-scaled pixels
draw.background: none (no drawRect in the debug branch)

left.debug: Minecraft.debug = <fps> + " fps, " + WorldRenderer.chunksUpdated + " chunk updates", rebuilt once per second (bao offset 600-655), chunksUpdated (blo.b) reset then

left.format: RenderGlobal.getDebugInfoRenders (bma.d): "C: " + renderersBeingRendered + "/" + renderersLoaded + ". F: " + renderersBeingClipped + ", O: " + renderersBeingOccluded + ", E: " + renderersSkippingRenderPass
RenderGlobal.getDebugInfoEntities (bma.e): "E: " + countEntitiesRendered + "/" + countEntitiesTotal + ". B: " + countEntitiesHidden + ", I: " + (total - hidden - rendered)
bao.t: "P: " + EffectRenderer.getStatistics (bkn.b: layers 0..2 sizes summed) + ". T: " + World.getDebugLoadedEntities (ahb.z: "All:" + loadedEntityList.size())
String.format("x: %.5f (%d) // c: %d (%d)", posX, floor(posX), floor(posX) >> 4, floor(posX) & 15)
String.format("y: %.3f (feet pos, %.3f eyes pos)", boundingBox.minY, posY)
left.note: floor(posY) is the block Y used below; posY is the eye position

left.format: String.format("z: %.5f (%d) // c: %d (%d)", posZ, floor(posZ), floor(posZ) >> 4, floor(posZ) & 15)

left.only: world != null && world.blockExists(floor x, floor y, floor z)
left.format: "lc: " + (chunk.getTopFilledSegment() + 15) + " b: " + chunk.getBiomeGenForWorldCoords(x & 15, z & 15, chunkManager).biomeName + " bl: " + chunk.getSavedLightValue(Block, x & 15, y, z & 15) + " sl: " + chunk.getSavedLightValue(Sky, x & 15, y, z & 15) + " rl: " + chunk.getBlockLightValue(x & 15, y, z & 15, 0)
String.format("ws: %.3f, fs: %.3f, g: %b, fl: %d", capabilities.getWalkSpeed (yw.b, 0.1F), capabilities.getFlySpeed (yw.a, 0.05F), onGround, world.getHeightValue(floor x, floor z))

right.format: "Used memory: " + used * 100 / max + "% (" + used / 1024 / 1024 + "MB) of " + max / 1024 / 1024 + "MB"

profilerPie.condition: showDebugInfo && showDebugProfilerChart; Profiler.profilingEnabled is turned on (and cleared when it was off), else off (bao offsets 340-405)
profilerPie.coordinates: raw display pixels (glOrtho 0..displayWidth, displayHeight..0), not GUI scaled; text drawn unscaled
profilerPie.backPanel: Tessellator.setColorRGBA_I(0, 200) quad x +-176 (1.1 * radius), y from center - 96 - 16 to center + 320
profilerPie.sectors: per Result row: steps = floor(use / 4) + 1; top fan colour = (name.hashCode() & 0xAAAAAA) + 0x444444, ellipse half height (cos * radius * 0.5); side strip 10 px tall, colour (c & 0xFEFEFE) >> 1

sectionText.header: (name != "unspecified" ? "[0]" : "") + (name.length == 0 ? "ROOT" : name + " ") at (cx - 160, cy - 96), white; total % right aligned at cx + 160
sectionText.rows: (row == "unspecified" ? "[?]" : "[" + (i + 1) + "]") + name at (cx - 160, cy + 80 + 8 i + 20) in the sector colour; use % right aligned at cx + 110, total % at cx + 160

profilerPie.digits: while the chart shows, key 0 (LWJGL 11) goes to the parent (lastIndexOf(".")), keys 1-9 (LWJGL 2-10) descend into the nth row unless it is "unspecified" (bao.b(int))

hotkeys.F3+S (31): bao.c (refreshResources) then, inside bao.c, bma.a (loadRenderers); bytecode-read. There is no separate sound reload in 1.7.10: SoundHandler reloads as a resource-manager reload listener inside the same call. Port (batch 22): resource-refresh.js refreshResources() in place plus every chunk mesh marked dirty.
hotkeys.F3+T (20): identical to F3+S (same bao.c call, bytecode-read). Port: same.
hotkeys.F3+F (33): with F3 and Shift or no Shift: bbj.a(bbm.f RENDER_DISTANCE, +-1) only where the option exists; the key block saves nothing else (bytecode-read at 836-880). Port: saves options. No chat message.
hotkeys.F3+A (30): bma.a() loadRenderers (bytecode-read). No chat message. Port verified live: marks every chunk mesh dirty.
hotkeys.F3+H (35): bbj.v (advancedItemTooltips) toggle + bbj.b (saveOptions) (bytecode-read). No chat message in 1.7.10 (the whole key block from F3+S to F3+P contains no chat call: later versions print 'Advanced tooltips: shown/hidden'). Port verified live: toggles and saves.
hotkeys.F3+B (48): bao: bnn.p = !bnn.p (bytecode-read, requires F3 down). RenderManager.renderEntityStatic/bnn.a(sa,DDDFFZ) calls bnn.b(sa,DDDFF) when bnn.p, !entity.isInvisible() (sa.ap) and the shadow-only flag is false. Port (batch 22): debug-keys.js HitboxRenderer.
hotkeys.F3+P (25): bbj.w (pauseOnLostFocus) toggle + saveOptions (bytecode-read). No chat message. Port verified live.
hotkeys.F3+C: held 6 s crash (bao.am timestamp on key 46). Not ported.
absent in 1.7.10: lagometer / frame-time graph (bbj.ay is read only by bao: the profiler pie and its digit keys)
hotkeys.F3+C (46): bao runTick keyboard loop (bytecode-read): C and F3 down with no stamp sets bao.am = Minecraft.getSystemTime(); with a stamp, on every keyboard event: now - stamp >= 6000 throws s(new b("Manually triggered debug crash", new Throwable())) BEFORE the key test, else the stamp resets to -1 if C or F3 is up. Fires even if released on that event. Port: crashStep() + a non-destructive dialog (the JVM would write crash-reports and exit).
hotkeys.any screen: The whole F1/F3/F4 block in runTick runs after Screen.handleKeyboardInput with no currentScreen test: F1, F3 and every F3 combination work in every GUI (bytecode-read). The port (batch 22) now handles them on every screen but the title.

port.title: fps from the main loop; chunk updates = scene.buildChunk calls per second (one per column mesh, native counts 16^3 WorldRenderers) - assumed approximation
port.renderers: assumed: sections = resident mesh columns * height/16; rendered = sections inside the camera frustum; F = loaded - rendered; O and E fixed 0
port.entities: assumed: mobs, items, XP orbs, carts, boats, hanging entities by frustum sphere test (sampled 4 times a second) + the local player (rendered only in third person); B = frustum-culled
port.chunkCache: world.chunks.size or the mesh column count, listed = loaded
port.memory: assumed: performance.memory (Chromium) jsHeapSizeLimit / totalJSHeapSize / usedJSHeapSize; others use navigator.deviceMemory or 0
port.lc: highest non-air block in the chunk, rounded down to a 16 section, + 15
port.profilerPie: second Profiler over the frame: root.tick (particles/tick/bed/effects/player phases) and root.render; unspecified is the rest

hitboxes.gate: bnn.p && !entity.isInvisible() (sa.ap) && !renderOnlyShadow flag; also only for entities that have a renderer (bnn.a(sa) != null)
hitboxes.box: (x - width/2, y, z - width/2) to (x + width/2, y + height, z + width/2), camera-relative x/y/z, using Entity.width (sa.M) and Entity.height (sa.N); NOT expanded (no expand/grow call), NOT the collision AABB
hitboxes.geometry: Tessellator mode 3 (GL_LINE_STRIP): bottom ring (minX,minY,minZ)->(maxX,..,minZ)->(maxX,..,maxZ)->(minX,..,maxZ)->back to start; top ring the same at maxY; then mode 1 (GL_LINES) for the four verticals
hitboxes.glState: glDepthMask(false); glDisable TEXTURE_2D (3553), LIGHTING (2896), CULL_FACE (2884), BLEND (3042); depth test untouched (stays enabled); afterwards texture/lighting/cull enabled again, blend disabled, depth mask true
hitboxes.lineWidth: never set in this code path: whatever glLineWidth was last set. RenderGlobal's block selection box sets 2.0F (bma.a(yz,azt,int) fconst_2) and nothing resets it; EntityRenderer's profiler/pie code sets 1.0F. So the native width is 2.0 after a block outline has been drawn, otherwise 1.0 (assumed from that ordering). WebGL lines are always 1 px.
hitboxes.notInVersion: no eye-height line, no look vector, no blue/red parts (all 1.8+)
hitboxes.portSizes: mobs: ENTITY_TYPES width/height (bytecode-read per class in earlier batches), calves 0.5 (assumed 1.7.10 setScale-free halving as the port's mobTargets); items 0.25; XP orbs 0.5; carts 0.98 x 0.7; boats 1.5 x 0.6; arrows 0.5; throwables and rockets 0.25; fireballs their width; primed TNT 0.98 and hanging entities 0.5 x 0.5 (assumed, from hanging.js note); the local player 0.6 x 1.8 only in third person (RenderGlobal.renderEntities draws the view entity only then)
hitboxes.notDrawn: falling blocks, lightning, fishing bobbers, eyes of ender, ender crystals, wither skulls from the skull list and dragon parts (native parts have no renderer, so no box; the dragon's own 16 x 8 box is drawn when it is in ENTITY_TYPES) are not collected unless listed above: assumed gap

crash.checkedOn: every keyboard event (press, auto-repeat, release), not on a timer
crash.portFlow: non-destructive dialog 'Oops, Minecraft has crashed! (simulated)' with the report text and a Back to game button; the world is untouched (assumed presentation; native shows the crash dialog and exits)

overlayOverGui: GuiIngame.renderGameOverlay runs in EntityRenderer.updateCameraAndRender before currentScreen.drawScreen (bytecode-read order), so the debug text sits under the GUI's dark gradient and panel. Port: #debug lives in #hud, below #modal; updateDebugOverlay() now runs on the playing, inventory, game-menu and death frames.
